description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'OldEnvironmentStatistics' implementing environment statistic interfaces, wrapping an 'IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider' to expose CPU, memory usage, and physical memory data.

classes.name: OldEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An internal sealed class providing environment statistics, marked as obsolete, wrapping an 'IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider'.

methods.name: CpuUsage
methods.description: Property that returns the CPU usage percentage as a nullable float.

methods.name: MemoryUsage
methods.description: Property that returns the current memory usage in bytes as a nullable long.

methods.name: AvailableMemory
methods.description: Property that returns the available memory in bytes as a nullable long.

methods.name: TotalPhysicalMemory
methods.description: Property that returns the maximum available memory in bytes as a nullable long.
